item.title: Making the plan
item.description:
Introduction

Today I decided to start a new project that involves a Raspberry PI an IP camera and some wheels I once got as a gift. The idea is building a vehicle that can move forward, backward and can make turns. As easy as this sounds this should be possble remotely.

The IP camera will send a live feed to whatever device is used to watch the stream the camera is sending. We had a security camera laying around that was never installed properly so to make use of it now seems appropriate for a project called Scrap Rover. chuckle
